title: PHB class content scope correction and directly referenced p.34 support
status: addendum to the pre-repair baseline; preserves rather than rewrites the earlier baseline

supersedesBaselineClaim.incorrectClaim: The dual-class procedure begins on p.33 and continues across the page boundary into adjacent p.34 text.
supersedesBaselineClaim.correction: The dual-class discussion continues from bottom-left to top-right within printed p.33; it does not continue onto p.34. Printed p.34 begins the Alignment section and then has the directly referenced Character Hit Points and Character Languages support sections.
supersedesBaselineClaim.reason: The whole printed p.34 (supplied PDF p.35) was rendered and viewed after the baseline claim was written. The original baseline bytes are preserved; this addendum is the correction.

fullPageRender.storage: Private temporary review file only; not copied to the repository.

boundedPage34Units.heading: CHARACTER HIT POINTS
boundedPage34Units.scope: Printed p.34 definition blocks relevant to class hit-die type, starting hit dice, hit-point accrual, maximum initially established hit points, and healing cap. The surrounding p.34 alignment discussion and unrelated character-creation text are not asserted reviewed as a complete source unit.
boundedPage34Units.sourceDenominator: One headed supporting section; prose clauses are not fully atomized, so the clause denominator remains unknown.

currentJoin.evidence: Current rule summary covers what hit points represent and recording current/maximum HP; bullets say hit-die type and exceptional starting dice depend on class. It is a summary, not the full printed section. Class records separately store hitDie and selected level changes.

boundedPage34Units.heading: CHARACTER LANGUAGES
boundedPage34Units.scope: Printed p.34 general/alignment language statements and directly class-relevant druid secret-tongue and thief-secret-speech references. The subsequent language-learning procedure is included only as a support pointer, not re-audited clause by clause.
boundedPage34Units.sourceDenominator: One headed supporting section; its multiple language categories and prose rules are not fully atomized, so the clause denominator remains unknown.

currentJoin.evidence: The rule summaries cover learning a language and alignment change; neither records the class-specific druid secret language or Thieves’ Cant as a class feature. Before-content probes using `secret tongue` in druid and `thieves cant` in thief did not match the actual a46 class records; after the two additions, both phrases match their respective prepared class documents. The proposal adds those source-backed reminders to the Druid and Thief guidance only.

classGuidanceAdditions.text: PHB pp. 21, 34: druids have a separate secret tongue, in addition to the common, alignment, and other languages they know.
PHB pp. 27, 34: all thieves know Thieves’ Cant in addition to other languages they may learn through race or Intelligence.

scopeDisposition.includedAdjacentSupport: Directly class-referenced p.34 Character Hit Points and Character Languages sections, limited to the facts named above.
